description: One slice of project data, when the overview is not enough. Slices: channels_90d (visits, signups, revenue and number of posts per source over 90 days); posts_30d (posts of the last 30 days with the visits, signups and revenue each brought); releases_30d (shipped releases and merged changes of the last 30 days (ids usable in uptake_write_post), with their drafts); revenue_by_day_30d (revenue and number of payments per day over 30 days); moments (communication moments: upcoming (ids usable in uptake_write_post), done and skipped); reports_4w (summaries of the last 4 weekly reports and their moves); mentions_7d (what people said about the product in the last 7 days); scheduled_7d (posts scheduled for the next 7 days); time_by_channel_30d (time the maker spent per network over 30 days); google_search_28d (Google Search clicks, impressions and top queries over 28 days); places_28d (results per named place (subreddit, newsletter issue) over 28 days).

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.
